title: Manual Intelligence Engine Method
invariants: source records and analyst claims are separate objects
source provenance has explicit fields for title, issuer/author, URL/location, publication/version, source date, checked/retrieved date, relevant locator, source type and collection note
a source cannot enter the register without a title and checked/retrieved date
a claim cannot be marked verified until the reviewer records a non-empty verification note describing what was checked
clearing the verification note demotes a verified claim back to unverified
only claims explicitly marked verified with a retained verification note appear as verified findings
contradicted and uncertain claims remain visible in separate brief sections
removing a source removes claims that depend on that source
reset/start over clears sources, claims, drafts and derived brief state
export preserves source provenance, claims, statuses, verification notes and derived brief buckets
evidenceBoundary: The engine records source provenance, a human verification decision and the reviewer's note about what was checked; it does not independently determine whether a source or claim is true.
privacy: No build-specific transmission or persistence path; exported JSON is created locally on explicit user action.
